about: T. Kevin Mooney is a distinguished attorney based in Atlanta, Georgia, practicing at his firm, T. Kevin Mooney, Attorney at Law. He focuses on DUI and criminal defense, serving clients primarily in the Atlanta Metro area. His background as a former Georgia prosecutor gives him unique insights into DUI cases, allowing him to provide strategic defense for his clients.

Mr. Mooney's extensive experience in the legal field is bolstered by his prior role as an assistant district attorney in Georgia, where he spent years prosecuting DUI cases on behalf of the state. This experience provides him with a thorough understanding of how the prosecution approaches such cases, which he now uses to benefit his clients. His ability to anticipate the prosecution's moves and counter them effectively is a significant advantage for those he represents. His clients often come through referrals from past clients, fellow attorneys, court employees and even police officers, reflecting the trust and respect he has earned in the legal community.

Educated at Wake Forest University, where he earned a Bachelor of Arts in 1986, Mr. Mooney went on to obtain his Juris Doctor with honors from the University of Florida Levin College of Law in 1991. He was admitted to practice law in Georgia in 1992, and the following year, he gained admission to practice before the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Georgia. Additionally, he is admitted to practice in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia, the Georgia Court of Appeals and the Georgia Supreme Court.

In addition to his legal prowess, Mr. Mooney is multilingual, being proficient in Spanish and Japanese, which allows him to assist a broader range of clients. His dedication and skill have earned him an AV Preeminent peer-review rating* through Martindale-Hubbell and a “Superb” rating on Avvo, underscoring his acumen and talents in legal defense.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
